tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Onde trabalha a tua irmã?”

B hears the question and builds the answer. A tile like “o meu / a minha” is a choice: in Portugal the possessive comes with the article, and it matches the thing you have (a minha irmã, os meus irmãos), not the owner. For “his” and “her” use dele and dela after the noun: o carro dele, a casa dela. A tile in brackets, like (ele), says who; do not write it.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Finally: swap cards and do it all again, faster.
